title: Hold a driving instructor licence
what: Hold the state's driving instructor licence, authority or accreditation before giving driving lessons for reward.

sources.title: Motor Vehicles Act 1959 (SA)
sources.publisher: SA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: 98A—Instructors' licences (1) A person who is not the holder of a current motor driving instructor's licence must not, for fee, reward, salary, wages or other remuneration or for any other consideration paid or payable by any person, teach any other person to drive a motor vehicle.

sources.title: Motor driving instructors licence
sources.publisher: Australian Business Licence and Information Service (ABLIS)
sources.quote: You will need this licence if you intend to conduct work as a motor vehicle driving instructor for fee or reward.

confidence_note: Quoted from the law's current text on 10 Nov 2026, replacing the ABLIS-first draft (methods rule 5a); the ABLIS listing stays as a reach source.

assessment.summary: Driving instructors need a licence, with a test and checks, before giving lessons for reward.

marks.reason: An instructor's licence is needed before trading.
Licensing narrows who may teach driving for reward.
